model_annotations.Bulgarian: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different neural network layers, using a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22 with integer tick marks, representing discrete layer indices. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale, with major ticks every 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” starts near 0.2 at layer 0 and steadily declines to nearly 0.0 by layer 22. An orange dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” begins near 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.5 by layer 5, and then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 through layer 22. A green dash-dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” also starts near 1.0 at layer 0, declines to about 0.15 by layer 10, and remains relatively low with minor fluctuations until layer 22. All three lines show a general downward trend in sparsity ratio as layer index increases, with the “after gate” and “after average gate” lines exhibiting more variability than the “before gate” line.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different neural network layers, using a threshold of 1e-2. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale, with major ticks every 0.2. An orange dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” begins near 1.0 at layer 0, declines steeply to about 0.5 by layer 5, then continues decreasing more gradually to approximately 0.2 by layer 15, followed by oscillations between 0.2 and 0.4 through layer 22. A green dash-dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” also starts near 1.0 at layer 0, drops to about 0.6 by layer 5, continues declining to around 0.15 by layer 15, and fluctuates slightly between 0.1 and 0.15 until layer 22. All lines show a general downward trend with varying degrees of noise and post-plateau variability.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different neural network layers, using a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22 with integer tick marks, representing discrete layer indices. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale, with major ticks at 0.2 intervals. Three distinct lines are plotted: the blue dashed line (“sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”) starts near 0.2 at layer 0 and steadily declines to nearly 0.0 by layer 22. The orange dotted line (“sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”) begins near 1.0, drops sharply to ~0.5 by layer 5, then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 with noticeable peaks around layers 20–22. The green dash-dotted line (“sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”) also starts near 1.0, declines more gradually than the orange line to ~0.1 by layer 22, with minor oscillations. All three lines show decreasing sparsity with increasing layer depth, though the post-gate lines remain significantly higher than the pre-gate line.
